svg.aria-label: The same grid of 20 equal blocks on 2 GPUs whose SMs each hold 2 blocks at a time. Top, 4 SMs, 8 places: blocks 0 to 7 run in wave 1, 8 to 15 in wave 2, and 16 to 19 in wave 3 on SMs 0 and 1 while SMs 2 and 3 are idle; 20 blocks in 3 waves of 8 places, 83.3 percent busy. Bottom, 8 SMs, 16 places: blocks 0 to 15 run in wave 1 and 16 to 19 in wave 2 on SMs 0 and 1 while 6 SMs are idle; 20 blocks in 2 waves of 16 places, 62.5 percent busy.
svg.text: 20 blocks on 4 SMs and on 8 SMs
Each SM holds 2 blocks at a time; every block takes the same time.
20 blocks / 8 places = 2.5 waves; the last wave fills 4 of 8 places
20 blocks / 16 places = 1.25 waves; the last wave fills 4 of 16 places
